Explicit algebraic checker verifies all coefficient identities; no reliance on finite time as an infinite-time proof.

value.rationale: At the exact nonhyperbolic invasion threshold, an explicit global extinction theorem and quantitative physical-time decay are not consequences of strict local eigenvalue analysis. The universal leading amplitude K−1 and feedback-sensitive logarithmic L distinguish two mechanisms in one model.
